extDescription.message: Learn Swedish while you browse: Swedeline swaps some words on English, German, French and Spanish pages for Swedish ones.

cmdToggleSite.message: Turn Swedeline on or off for the current site

statsSummary.description: Popup usage sentence; $WORDS$ is statsWordsOne/Other, $PAGES$ is statsPagesOne/Other

statsWordsOne.description: Inside statsSummary, for one word; $N$ is a number

statsWordsOther.description: Inside statsSummary, for several words; $N$ is a number

statsPagesOne.description: Inside statsSummary, for one page; $N$ is a number

statsPagesOther.description: Inside statsSummary, for several pages; $N$ is a number

statsNone.message: Swedeline hasn't inserted any Swedish words yet.
statsNone.description: Popup usage sentence before any word was inserted

reviewTitle.description: Review request heading; $COUNT$ is a large number (20,000, 50,000, 100,000, ...), $ORD$ is the Swedish word "ord" (words), highlighted like a replaced word

reviewText.message: Enjoying Swedeline? A short rating $STORE$ helps other Swedish learners find it.
reviewText.description: Review request; $STORE$ is reviewStoreChrome or reviewStoreFirefox, with its preposition

reviewStoreChrome.description: Inside reviewText; keep "Chrome Web Store" untranslated

reviewYes.description: Review request: main button, opens the store

reviewLater.description: Review request: asks again at the next milestone

reviewNever.description: Review request: small link, never asks again

statusActive.description: $LANG$ is a language name, $COUNT$ a number

statusSwedish.message: This page is already in Swedish.

statusNoText.message: No longer texts on this page yet.

statusUnavailable.message: Swedeline can't run on this page.

statusReload.message: Reload the page to start Swedeline here.

shortcutHowTo.message: Open the browser's extension settings and choose "Manage shortcuts".
shortcutHowTo.description: Shown when the shortcut page cannot be opened directly

grantAccessHint.message: Swedeline needs access to websites to show Swedish words.

credits.message: Dictionaries built from WikDict (Wiktionary, CC BY-SA) and FrequencyWords (CC BY-SA 4.0). Works offline, no data leaves your browser.
